annotation.title_clean: Responsabilidad Algorítmica y Promoción de la Robótica, Algoritmos Verdes e Inteligencia Artificial en la República Argentina
annotation.title_en: Algorithmic Accountability and Promotion of Robotics, Green Algorithms and Artificial Intelligence in the Argentine Republic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Maximiliano Ferraro, Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
annotation.venue: Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación (Argentina)
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill by Deputy Maximiliano Ferraro establishing a general legal framework for AI: algorithmic accountability and transparency, OECD-style principles, an ad honorem AI Advisory Council, good-practice certifications, a significant-risk registry and SME promotion. Despite "robotics" in the title, it contains no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines AI actors (providers, deployers, importers, distributors, manufacturers, affected persons) with extraterritorial reach
Sets principles: inclusive growth, human-centred values, transparency, robustness, accountability, risk prevention, SME protection, control of state surveillance
Creates an eight-member ad honorem AI Advisory Council
Creates good-practice certifications and a registry of significant risks
Promotes AI adoption in SMEs and green algorithms
